name: Lawyer

pf.license.need: Always: each lawyer's own license to practice, active and in good standing, in the state of the customer's matter. The firm: a registration where the state's rules require one. Each notary: their own commission.
pf.license.ask: Each lawyer's bar number at sign-up or in their invite reply. The firm's registration where the state form asks. Each notary's commission number and end date.
pf.license.who holds it: Each lawyer; the firm where the state's rules require it; each notary.
pf.license.how it's checked: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks going live: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.renewals: Checked on each renewal date from the state form; a lapsed license pauses that lawyer's bookings, and Sam is told.
pf.license.insurance: Malpractice insurance on file, or shown to customers, where the state's rules require it; the amount comes from the state form.

pf.services.pattern: Consult: a meeting with a licensed lawyer. In the office, or by video or phone (flow A). At the customer's home, a hospital or a care home (flow B). Every new matter waits for the firm's conflict check before it books.

pf.services.the case itself: Never booked or priced in Rosie. Hourly rates, flat fees and retainers go in the firm's own engagement letter.
pf.services.capacity: One lawyer per booking. A signing also needs two witnesses from the firm's staff, and a notary where the state's rules require one.
pf.services.online: Video and phone consults count as at the office, only with a lawyer licensed in the state the customer is in that day. Signing or notarizing by video only where the state's rules allow it.
pf.services.booking window: Up to 3 weeks ahead; no same-day consults unless the firm allows them (the firm's settings).
pf.services.blocked times: Court days and hearings block consult times, from the lawyer's calendar or a BLOCK text.

pf.questions.who may book: An adult books for themselves. Another adult may book for a parent or a spouse, but the person the matter is about gives their own names and yes on the secure page, and meets the lawyer alone. A teen's consult: a parent books.

what Rosie says.abuse or fear: If you're in danger, call 911. The National Domestic Violence Hotline is 1-800-799-7233, any time. The booking goes on, and Rosie asks how it's safe to reach the customer.
what Rosie says.pushed to sign: The lawyer meets you alone first. The booking goes on.

pf.safety.legal questions: Never answered: they wait for the lawyer at the consult. In danger, 911 comes first.

required: The conflict check, before every new matter books: Priya, the paralegal, or the lawyer named checks the names on the secure page against the firm's records (clients, past would-be clients and other sides), and replies Clear, Conflict or Need more.
The time stays saved for the check, up to 1 business day (the firm's setting). No answer by then: the request ends, and nothing is owed.
A moved booking, or a follow-up on the same matter, keeps its check: same people, same matter.
A home or hospital signing: the papers are drafted first, after a consult, and two witnesses and any notary are booked with the lawyer.
prep for the reminder: Bring any court papers you got, and a short list of questions.
A signing: have a photo ID and the draft the firm sent, and be ready to meet the lawyer alone.

pf.visit.check-in: At the office: the code at the front desk. Video or phone: the lawyer asks for the code at the start. At a home or hospital: the code at the door, then the lawyer checks the signer's photo ID.
pf.visit.at check-in: The customer signs the firm's own consult form: what they say is private, and the lawyer isn't theirs until they agree in writing.
pf.visit.work changes: Extra time or a document review is priced before it's done. A second consult is its own visit. The case itself is never booked in Rosie.
pf.visit.a conflict found at the consult: The lawyer stops, charges nothing, and adds the name to the firm's conflict records. The customer is told they need another lawyer, with no name suggested.
pf.visit.a signing: The lawyer meets the signer alone first, and checks they understand and want it. If someone presses them, that part stops and the lawyer sets another time to meet alone.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The code, or DONE. A signing's DONE comes once every page is signed, witnessed and notarized.
pf.visit.after the consult: The firm decides, from its own tools: an engagement letter, nothing while the customer thinks it over, or a letter saying it won't take the case.
pf.visit.originals: A signed original will can stay in the firm's safe; the customer gets copies.

pf.money.before: Nothing taken is the starting answer. A card saved only for a missed-consult fee the firm sets. Home and hospital visits: the $89 travel fee held, or a card saved.
pf.money.never before: No deposit and no full price through Rosie. Money paid before the work is an advance fee, which belongs in the firm's trust account, and Rosie never touches trust money.
pf.money.after: At the office: paid at the front desk, the firm's own way. Video or phone: Rosie texts the bill, or charges the saved card at DONE. Visits: Rosie texts the bill, charges the saved card, or the firm bills its own way.
pf.money.retainers: Only through the firm's own trust account tools, never through Rosie. Card fees never come out of trust.
pf.money.fees: Missed-consult or late-cancel fee: none by default. A firm may set one; it's shown before booking, and Sam confirms each.
pf.money.free consults: A free first consult takes nothing before and nothing after.
pf.money.tax: None by default; where the state's rules tax legal services, the rate comes from the state form.
pf.money.deposit cap: Not used: no deposits through Rosie.
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies to law work, as to every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, shown at sign-up for the owner's yes, not a share of what the firm charges; a booking the firm puts in itself carries no $2; card payments cost only Stripe's own card fee, paid to Stripe. A lawyer reviews the fee terms before launch

never in a text: what the matter is about, beyond the kind picked
why a conflict check didn't clear
pf.messages.safe to text: If the customer says texts or email aren't safe, Rosie uses only the way they pick: the secure page, an email, or a call from the firm. Any text then names only the firm's plain name and the time.
pf.messages.a conflict: Never explained. No other lawyer is suggested, and Rosie never contacts the other side.
pf.messages.no nudges: No follow-up texts about hiring the lawyer.
pf.messages.case notes: The lawyer's notes go in the firm's own file, never in Rosie. Rosie keeps only the time, the kind of matter and the outcome.
pf.messages.minors: A parent books a teen's consult, and the texts go to the parent.

pf.staff.licenses: Each lawyer's active license in each state they take matters in. A video or phone consult is offered only with a lawyer licensed in the state the customer is in that day.
skills: Notary work: a notary's own commission
pf.staff.supervision: A paralegal or office manager may run the desk and the conflict check, but never gives legal advice and never holds a consult.
pf.staff.witnesses: Adults on the firm's staff who aren't named in the papers.
pf.staff.who OKs what: The conflict check: Priya, the paralegal, or the lawyer named. Sam OKs prices made for one customer. Sam's answer wins.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Only another lawyer at the same firm, offered by the firm and picked by the customer by name. Rosie never suggests one.

pf.rules.named only: Rosie's rule for lawyers: it books only a lawyer or firm the customer names. It never suggests, matches, ranks or rates lawyers, and sends no rating request.
pf.rules.notice at booking: Rosie isn't a law firm and gives no legal advice. The lawyer isn't yours until they agree in writing. Before the check, share only names and the kind of matter.
pf.rules.written fee agreement: The engagement letter, from the firm's own tools, in writing where the state's rules require it.
pf.rules.listing facts: Any fact the state's rules require on a lawyer's listing, like an office address or a responsible lawyer's name, from the state form.
pf.rules.before launch: A state on the before-launch list goes live only after counsel's written OK.
pf.rules.agreement: The firm signs a confidentiality agreement before going live: Rosie keeps client details private and uses them only for booking.
pf.rules.records: Booking records 7 years. Case files stay in the firm's own system, never in Rosie.
pf.rules.right to cancel: Legal work sold at the home comes with a written right to cancel, where the state's rules require it.
pf.rules.remote signing: Signing or notarizing by video only where the state's rules allow it.
pf.rules.status: Draft: finalized once the state forms are filled in.

matter most.no lawyer named: No search. Rosie books only a lawyer or firm the customer names.
matter most.a conflict: Told without the reason; nothing owed; no other lawyer suggested.
matter most.need more for the check: One question on the secure page, with a deadline; no answer by then: the request ends, nothing owed.
matter most.a conflict found at the consult: The lawyer stops; nothing is charged.
matter most.a case question by text or chat: Never answered; it waits for the lawyer.
matter most.texts aren't safe: Only the way the customer picks; plain texts with no matter.
matter most.a family member books for a parent: The parent gives their own yes and meets the lawyer alone.
matter most.the lawyer is called to court: New times with the same lawyer, or a free cancel; the check carries over.
matter most.a no-show: No fee, unless the firm set one and the customer agreed to it.
matter most.a hospital's rules: The visit fits the visiting hours; a ward that says no moves it, with no fee.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
